title: Payment Terms and Collection Thresholds — Sentinel Managed Security
content:
Accounts receivable applies the following payment terms and collection thresholds to Sentinel Managed Security invoices, by tier.

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Payment terms | Net payment terms from the invoice posted date (whole days) |
| Monthly late fee | Monthly late fee on an invoice's unpaid balance past the grace period (percent) |
| Late fee grace period | Calendar days after the due date before a late fee is assessed (whole days) |
| Suspension threshold | Days past due of the oldest unpaid invoice at which SOC monitoring is suspended (whole days) |
| Termination threshold | Days in suspension after which the subscription may be terminated (whole days) |

| Sentinel tier | Payment terms (days) | Monthly late fee | Grace period (calendar days) | Suspension threshold (days past due) | Termination threshold (days in suspension) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sentinel EDR Essentials | Net 15 | 1.5 percent | 5 | 30 | 30 |
| Sentinel MDR Standard | Net 30 | 1.5 percent | 5 | 45 | 30 |
| Sentinel MDR Advanced | Net 30 | 1.5 percent | 5 | 45 | 30 |
| Sentinel MDR Complete | Net 30 | 1.5 percent | 10 | 60 | 45 |
| Sentinel XDR Premier | Net 30 | 1.5 percent | 10 | 60 | 45 |
| Sentinel XDR Enterprise | Net 45 | 1.5 percent | 15 | 75 | 60 |

## Observations

- The monthly late fee is 1.5 percent on every tier; the tiers differ in payment terms, grace period and the two thresholds.
- The suspension threshold is counted against the oldest unpaid invoice, in days past its due date; the termination threshold is counted in days of suspension.
- Sentinel XDR Enterprise has the longest figures in every column but the late fee.
